answer: The pearl index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1989 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ivory. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the cipher queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 454 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
